name: The Worst Root
pitch: Your root is so poor that wards cannot notice your hits, so you keep every strike under a line and refuse every cure, because twenty more points of damage would lose you the fight.

new.name: Dull Root
new.effect: Derived, reads its parents upside down. Needs n_base 3 or more, every element below 50; chance 1. Purity round(100 - 2 x mean purity), 1 to 80. Per element held: one part per hit. Per purity point: the line rises 0.05 % of the target's maximum health, attack_pct -0.5. Own sector as rule 12. Marrow-Cleansing Pills lower it.

new.name: Even Streams
new.effect: An art hit or basic attack splits into one equal part per base element held, each with that tag.

new.name: Unfelt
new.effect: A part under the line, before the ward, skips the ward. At or over it, the ward works as usual.
new.second_home: any build of very small hits

new.name: Dull Hand
new.effect: attack_pct -0.5 per purity point of the root.

new.name: Split Hit Damage
new.effect: Small +2, notable +12, on hits with three or more parts.

new.name: Many Streams
new.second_home: The Kept Hearth, any Conversion build

new.name: The Seven Beads
new.effect: Seven arts: Mộc, Hỏa, Thổ, Kim, Thủy Châu, Niệm Châu, Hồi Hướng. c_art 1.48, cost 0.04, 1 s.

new.name: Five Dregs Sutra
new.effect: Main, Thiên giai, names only the Dull Root, so it runs at the root's purity.

questions: Wards are the game's main defence. Is a size test before the ward acceptable, or should ward-skipping stay with ticks and soul?
A plain root with this stack still beats an ordinary mixed Deity. Is failing that swap acceptable when the plain character could never reach Deity?
The root forms by chance 1 in 2.174 % of births and lifts the 12.14 % variant rate. Should it be rarer, or be exempt from that target?
